title: 第19章 事发第20章 黑木崖
lines: 百草谷深处，有几栋偌大的木屋，正是朱震几人的居所。
“怎么样？王扶那小子最近有没有什么异常的举动？”
朱震老神在在的坐在椅子上。
“没有，我一直叫人盯着他，他每天除了修炼之外就是去清灵潭打坐，看不出什么出奇的地方。”
张恒摇摇头，一想到王扶他就恨得牙痒痒。
“不应该呀，短短几个月就从一个凡人修炼到炼气二重，还将法术修炼到了大成，要说没有奇遇怎么也说不过去，总不能真的和【厚土决】完美契合吧。”
朱震摸了摸下巴，不太相信，他自言自语道，“难道那小子不是五灵根？是双灵根？三灵根？不不不……不可能，若是三灵根双灵根直接就成正式弟子了，哪里会来小冬峰受罪。”
“继续盯着，另外你去清灵潭一趟，看看他待过的地方有没有什么特殊的地方……”
朱震似乎想到了什么，“算了，我亲自去一趟吧，你去负责黄铮的事，这小子无声无息就不见了，也不知道是溜走了还是死在哪了。”
张恒点点头，心里却在腹诽。
呵，亲自去？我看是怕有什么机缘被我抢先了吧，可惜清灵潭周围早就被我搜了个遍，至于黄铮，不见了就不见了，一个凡人蝼蚁而已。
见张恒离开，朱震这才慢悠悠的朝着清灵潭走去，说实话他不相信清灵潭有什么好东西，毕竟那个地方自己都逛过百八十回了，但心里总有那么一点期盼，若真有机缘岂不是错过？
“若是清灵潭没有，就去王扶的屋子看看，硬搜也要搜一遍，真有什么好宝贝哪怕杀人抢夺也做得来……”
小冬峰上，冯大富听着旁边人的汇报，脸色愈来愈黑。
“冯师兄，事情就是这样，那个王扶和赵泽霖赵师兄非但没有任何关系，反而还有仇怨才是……”
这人说完小心翼翼的看了看冯大富，见对方一脸严肃，哪里不知道此地不宜久留，连忙请示就要跑路，“那个，冯师兄我那里还有事没做完，就先离开了。”
冯大富摆了摆手，这人如释重负赶紧开溜。
“好啊好，真是不错，居然欺骗到我的头上来了，真以为我冯大富是个混吃等死的主么？泥人尚有三分火气呢……王扶，你小子给我等着。”
冯大富有仇从不隔夜，当下就起身出发，朝着百草谷气冲冲而去，甚至用上了御风术。
王扶正在木屋旁修炼遁地术，自上次之后他就找到了诀窍，只不过那种黄蒙蒙的灵力极难修炼，目前也覆盖一条小腿，想要达到覆盖全身的程度，任重而道远。
周围的风变大了不少，他忽然有感朝着远处望去，就见一个小黑点正疾驰而来，黑点越来越大，竟是一道人影。
“好快的速度……”
王扶刚吃惊没一会儿，就看清了人影的面貌，“冯大富……”
“他怎么来了？难不成黄铮一事暴露了？”
王扶心里一慌。
“不急不急，我不能露出马脚，问什么都说不知道，黄铮已经化作一抔黄土，不可能被发现。”
他故作镇定，静静等待。
不消几个呼吸，挺着肥胖肚子的冯大富就飘然而来，他黑着一张脸，死死的盯着王扶，似乎想看看面前这小子有什么胆子敢骗他。
“咦？你成修士了？”
结果他发现王扶周身有灵力波动，还不弱。
“见过冯师兄，”
content_en:
Deep in the Baicao Valley, there are several large wooden houses, which are the residences of Zhu Zhen and his friends.
"How's it going? Has that boy Wang Fu done anything unusual recently?"
Old God Zhu Zhen was sitting on the chair.
"No, I've been asking people to keep an eye on him. Apart from practicing every day, he goes to Qingling Pool to meditate. There's nothing surprising about him."
Zhang Heng shook his head, his teeth itching with hatred at the thought of Wang helping him.
"It shouldn't be. In just a few months, he has gone from being a mortal to the second level of Qi refining, and has also practiced his magic to great perfection. It's impossible to say that there are no adventures. It can't really fit perfectly with [Thick Earth Technique]."
Zhu Zhen touched his chin, not convinced, and said to himself, "Isn't that kid with five spiritual roots? Two spiritual roots? Three spiritual roots? No, no, no...impossible. If he has three spiritual roots and two spiritual roots, he becomes an official disciple directly. How can he come to Xiaodong Peak to suffer."
"Keep staring, and also go to Qinglingtan to see if there is anything special about the place where he stayed..."
Zhu Zhen seemed to have thought of something, "Forget it, I'll go there myself. You can take charge of Huang Zheng's affairs. This kid disappeared without a trace. I don't know if he slipped away or died somewhere."
"Yes."
Zhang Heng nodded, but he was cursing in his heart.
Oh, go in person? I think he was afraid that I would be the first to take advantage of him. Unfortunately, I had already searched the area around Qing Ling Pond. As for Huang Zheng, he was gone when he was gone. He was just a mortal ant.
Seeing Zhang Heng leaving, Zhu Zhen walked slowly towards Qinglingtan. To be honest, he didn't believe that there was anything good in Qinglingtan. After all, he had visited that place a hundred and eighty times, but there was always a little hope in his heart. If he really had the opportunity, wouldn't he miss it?
"If Qing Lingtan doesn't have it, go to Wang Fu's house and have a look, and do a hard search. If there really is any good treasure, you can kill and rob it..."
…
On Xiaodong Peak, Feng Dafu's face became darker and darker as he listened to the reports from the people next to him.
"Senior Brother Feng, that's what happened. Not only does Wang Fu have nothing to do with Senior Brother Zhao Zelin, but they actually have a grudge..."
After the man finished speaking, he looked at Feng Dafu cautiously. Seeing the seriousness on his face, he didn't know that it was not suitable to stay here for a long time. He quickly asked for instructions and was about to run away. "Well, Senior Brother Feng, I have some things to finish there, so I'll leave first."
Feng Dafu waved his hand, and the man quickly ran away with relief.
"Okay, okay, it's really good. You actually deceived me. Do you really think that I, Feng Dafu, is a man who just wants to eat and die? The clay figurine is still very angry...Wang Fu, you boy, just wait for me."
Feng Dafu never stayed overnight, so he got up and set off immediately, rushing towards Baicao Valley, and even used the wind control technique.
Wang Fu is practicing the Earth Escape Technique next to the wooden house. He has found the trick since the last time. However, that kind of yellow spiritual power is extremely difficult to cultivate. It currently only covers one calf. There is still a long way to go before it can cover the whole body.
The wind around him became much stronger. He suddenly felt that he looked into the distance and saw a small black dot speeding towards him. The black dot got bigger and bigger, and it turned out to be a human figure.
"So fast..."
Wang Fugang was surprised and soon saw the face of the figure clearly, "Feng Dafu..."
"Why is he here? Is it possible that Huang Zheng's case was exposed?"
Wang Fu panicked.
"Don't be hasty, don't be hasty, I can't show off my lies and tell you I don't know anything when asked. Huang Zheng has turned into a handful of loess and it is impossible to be discovered."
He pretended to be calm and waited quietly.
Within a few breaths, Feng Dafu floated over with a fat belly. He had a dark face and stared at Wang Fu, as if he wanted to see how dare this kid in front of him dared to lie to him.
"Huh? Have you become a monk?"
As a result, he found that Wang Fu had spiritual power fluctuations all over his body, and he was not weak at all.
"I've met Senior Brother Feng,"
